verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a company-formation and back-office platform, so a library of standard legal templates is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence covers only registered agent, compliance, accounting, tax, mailroom, banking access, and a Carta cap-table integration. Nothing in the pack shows a library of NDAs, agreements, or policy templates.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start from a library of vetted standard legal templates (NDAs, agreements, policies) instead of hiring counsel for routine documents
